_readme: What AI coding tools and model labs publish about instruction files, which model runs each job, effort settings and context. Every claim is one plain sentence plus a quote of at most 25 words copied verbatim from source_url, with the date it was checked. tier "tool" = the coding tool's own docs; tier "lab" = the model maker's own docs about its own models. scripts/check-sources.mjs re-fetches every source_url and fails if a quote is no longer on the page; scripts/validate-data.mjs checks the shape. tool_plans holds one plan per tool: where its instructions live, which settings it obeys, the lead (its documented default model and effort, or left to you), helpers (inherit the lead's model; a sourced push-down line for a near-full usage limit) and bulk (mechanical, checkable work) — every slot cites claim ids from the tool or its own lab. role_defaults records the helper jobs a tool's docs tie to a model; the install package does not apply them (helpers inherit). model_refs maps the strings a tool's config accepts (for example "sonnet") to catalog ids in data/models.json. effort_pages links each lab's own page on effort or reasoning settings. Nothing in this file ranks models against each other. Frozen test copy (taken 2026-10-03) for scripts/test-instructions.mjs and scripts/test-install.mjs: refresh by hand, never from an automated job.

claims.sentence: OpenRouter's Auto Router runs when a request sends openrouter/auto as the model.

claims.quote: low favors the cheapest capable models, while max favors the most capable models regardless of price.

claims.sentence: An OpenRouter Auto Router request with no cost setting routes roughly as the low band.
claims.quote: Requests that set no cost setting route as if you had asked for roughly the low band.

claims.sentence: OpenRouter charges the selected model's standard rate for Auto Router requests with no added fee.
claims.quote: There is no additional fee for using the Auto Router.

claims.sentence: OpenRouter's models parameter tries other models when the first model's providers are down, rate-limited or refuse the request.
claims.quote: The models parameter lets you automatically try other models if the primary model's providers are down

claims.sentence: OpenRouter prices a fallback request at the rate of the model that served it.
claims.quote: Requests are priced using the model that was ultimately used

claims.sentence: OpenRouter's :floor variant sorts a model's providers by price and admits flex-tier endpoints.
claims.quote: OpenRouter sorts the model's providers by price and also makes flex service tier endpoints eligible

claims.sentence: OpenRouter requests set reasoning effort or a reasoning token limit through the reasoning parameter.

claims.sentence: OpenRouter presets hold provider routing, model selection, system prompts and other parameters outside the calling code.
claims.quote: Presets allow you to separate your LLM configuration from your code.
